name: deflicker
what: evens out frame-to-frame brightness pulsing by matching each frame to the average of its neighbours (ffmpeg deflicker)
when: the whole picture pulses lighter and darker from frame to frame; not for scenes whose light really changes
softens: real, fast changes of light (lightning, a flash) are damped too
tried_on: written from restoration practice; runs and passes the guard on a 15 s cut of an owner cartoon that does not show this defect (safe to try). Whether it helps on a source that has the defect is not shown yet; note: on that clean cut it raised the flicker reading to 0.0175 (limit 0.02)
